summary: Add logic to rename category and update all receipts, enhance mileage validation to accept decimals, adjust UI components and layout for better mobile experience, and add acceptance tests for these changes.
steps: 1. Open src/lib/categories.ts and locate renameCategory function. Add logic to fetch all receipts, iterate and update any receipt whose category matches old name case-insensitively, then rename the category in the categories store. Ensure atomic behavior: if rename validation fails, do not modify receipts.
2. Ensure renameCategory validates the new name (non-empty, no duplicates, valid format) and checks existence of old name. On failure, return appropriate error string and make no changes.
3. Add isCategoryInUse(newName) usage after rename: after updating receipts, the function should return true for the new name if any receipt uses it.

4. Update src/lib/mileage.ts: modify validateMileageMiles to accept numbers >0 with at most one decimal place. Return error strings 'Miles must be > 0', 'Miles must be ≤ 10,000', or 'Miles must have at most 1 decimal place' as needed.

5. In src/screens/MileageEntryScreen.tsx, adjust the Miles TextInput to accept decimal strings, ensure the value is parsed as a number and stored with its decimal part, and display the calculated deduction based on the decimal miles.

6. Update UI components to meet design requirements: - PrimaryButton should be a single styled button without duplicate titles. - SimpleAddButtons (Receipt and Mileage add FABs) should be positioned so they do not overlay the Recent activity list and remain visible on 390x844 screens. - ScreenHeader should render the screen title only once in the header, not inside the screen body.

7. In src/screens/ReceiptEntryScreen.tsx, move the date picker icon inside the Date field component, remove extra gaps, ensure Scan receipt button only appears when scanning is supported (use expo-text-extractor.isSupported).

8. In src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx, replace the separate App lock button with a single switch row, and change other entries to list rows with chevrons; ensure Delete all data row uses error color and is placed last, separated by a divider.

- __tests__/categories_rename.test.ts: test successful rename updates receipts, categories list, syncCategoriesWithReceipts behavior, and isCategoryInUse. Also test failed rename leaves data unchanged.

- __tests__/mileage_decimal.test.ts: test validateMileageMiles accepts valid decimal values and rejects invalid ones, test that entering '12.5' on MileageEntryScreen stores the correct value and deduction.

- __tests__/ui_layout.test.ts: shallow render DashboardScreen, ReceiptEntryScreen, MileageEntryScreen, and SettingsScreen to verify the presence/absence of UI elements per spec (button overlay, title placement, scan button condition, App lock switch, entry rows). Use react-test-renderer or @testing-library/react-native.
10. Run jest to ensure all existing tests still pass and new tests succeed.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Runs the app's acceptance tests: the Jest files in __tests__/acceptance/. Generated by the pipeline; the tests
themselves are locked files written by the planner. ACCEPTANCE_MILESTONE=N runs only the tests of milestones 1..N."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
os.chdir(here)
if not os.path.isdir("node_modules"):
    lock = os.path.exists("package-lock.json")
    subprocess.run(["npm", "ci" if lock else "install", "--include=dev", "--no-audit", "--no-fund"], check=False, timeout=1500)
cmd = ["npx", "jest", "--ci", "__tests__/acceptance"]
m = os.environ.get("ACCEPTANCE_MILESTONE", "")
if m.isdigit():
    cmd += ["-t", "^(" + "|".join("M%d" % i for i in range(1, int(m) + 1)) + "): "]
# The app's own test script may add node flags (e.g. --experimental-vm-modules): use the same ones.
try:
    script = json.load(open("package.json")).get("scripts", {}).get("test", "")
except (OSError, ValueError):
    script = ""
env = dict(os.environ)
if "--experimental-vm-modules" in script:
    env["NODE_OPTIONS"] = (env.get("NODE_OPTIONS", "") + " --experimental-vm-modules").strip()
print("Running: " + " ".join(cmd), flush=True)
sys.exit(subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, timeout=1500).returncode)

requirements.text: When renameCategory is called for a default category, it must update every saved receipt whose category matches the old name case‑insensitively to the new name.
When renameCategory is called for a custom category, it must update every saved receipt whose category matches the old name case‑insensitively to the new name.
After a successful rename, getAllCategories must no longer list the old category name.
After a successful rename, syncCategoriesWithReceipts must not re‑introduce the old category name.
After a successful rename, isCategoryInUse(newName) must return true when receipts previously used the old name.
Renaming a category must leave receipts in other categories unchanged and must preserve all other fields of the updated receipts exactly.
If renameCategory fails because the new name is invalid, already exists, or the original category is not found, no receipt must be modified.
validateMileageMiles must accept any numeric value greater than 0 with at most one decimal place (e.g., 12.5).
validateMileageMiles must reject 0, negative numbers, numbers with more than one decimal place (e.g., 12.55), and non‑numeric text.
The Miles field on the Add Mileage screen must allow entry of a string such as "12.5".
The deduction amount shown on the Add Mileage screen and saved to storage must use the exact decimal value entered.
The Receipt add button, Mileage add button, and the "Receipt saved" confirmation must never overlap or cover any row in the Recent activity list.
Each activity row in the Recent activity list must display its amount.
The Recent activity list must be scrollable past the add buttons so that the buttons remain visible while scrolling.
On a 390x844 phone screen, the bottom tab bar labels (Dashboard, Receipts, Mileage, Settings) must be fully visible.
The Add Receipt screen title must appear only once, in the header.
The date picker icon must be positioned inside the Date input field.
There must be no empty vertical gaps larger than the standard spacing between input fields on the Add Receipt screen.
The "Scan receipt" button must be hidden when scanning functionality is not available.
In Settings, the App lock option must appear as a single switch row, without a separate button.

All other Settings entries (Tax settings, Categories, Export, Backup & restore, Delete all data, View Terms and Privacy Policy) must be displayed as list rows with a chevron icon, not as outlined buttons.
The Delete all data row must be rendered in the error color, placed last in the list, and separated visually from the other entries.
All existing features, tests, and screens must continue to work after the changes.
